svg.title: Allowed profile error: how far behind it may fall
svg.desc: Animated graph of position over time, drawn left to right. The dashed blue plan rises along an S from start to target. Below it, a shaded band as deep as the allowed profile error shows how far behind the plan the mechanism may fall. The solid orange measured position falls further and further behind until it touches the edge of the band; a red ring flashes there and MAXMotion re-plans from where it really is: a new dashed plan starts at the measured point and reaches the target later, while the rest of the old plan turns gray. Small: re-plans often, consistent motion, harder to see a bad tune. Large: shows the tune honestly but can lurch when it finally re-plans.
svg.text: Allowed profile error: how far behind it may fall
Fall this far behind the plan, and MAXMotion re-plans from where it really is.
Small: re-plans often, consistent motion, harder to see a bad tune.
Large: shows the tune honestly but can lurch when it finally re-plans.
